bugFixes.bugDescription: Reformat all characteristics that are not in JSON format. You can run the script " SELECT * FROM CoreFieldInstanceLocations WHERE ISJSON(Characteristic) = 0 " to identify the rows that need to be corrected. If there are too many rows to modify, you can limit your corrections to misformatted characteristics that include tooltipHover (add condition to check). The script 20241031_MoveTooltipHoverFromCharacteristicToProp.sql will run correctly when the rows with characteristics including tooltipHover are in the correct format.
